description: Create a post (share) from your connected account, optionally with media: up to 20 images (JPEG, PNG or GIF, 5 MB each), one MP4 video (50 MB) or one PDF document (25 MB), 50 MB in all. Give each file as a public https `url`, or inline as base64 `data` with its `filename` and `mime` (inline files share a 20 MB request). Text is optional with media. Costs $0.005 per action. Requires a connected account. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

files.description: 1 to 20 images, or one video, or one document.

data.description: The file as base64, instead of url.

filename.description: The file name; required with data.

mime.description: The file type; required with data.

url.description: A public https address of the file.

title.description: A title, shown on a document post.

text.description: The post text; required unless media is given.

visibility.description: Who can see it; defaults to anyone.

name: post_create
title: Create a Post
